export_limit.locator: Changes from late 2026; fixed export limit / flexible exports options
export_limit.verified_fact: The public guidance describes a fixed export option of 3 kW per site for new/upgraded solar/battery connections from late 2026; another static option for unreliable internet is 1.5 kW/site; flexible exports up to 10 kW/phase with lower limit 1.5 kW/site.
export_limit.adopted_design: 3 kW/site PCC cap as a forward-looking engineering scenario, consistently applied to all methods.
export_limit.boundary: Not a historical requirement for 2010-2013 Ausgrid data and not proof of eligibility of the simulated installations.

power_factor.verified_fact: The brochure states a customer obligation to maintain power factor 0.9 or above, in a business/customer power-factor-correction context.
power_factor.boundary: These are engineering scenarios, not an empirically measured household distribution or calibrated probabilistic uncertainty interval.

impedance.basis: Original named benchmark line parameters; network implementation retains transformer parameters.
impedance.adopted_design: Scale line R and X together by 0.90,1.00,1.10 one factor at a time relative to base setup.
impedance.boundary: A prespecified deterministic engineering stress range, not claimed to be supported as a measured 90/95% uncertainty interval by an external source. No citation can convert an analyst choice into empirical calibration.

volt_watt_not_adopted.verified_fact: Representative official inverter power-quality guidance specifies Volt-Watt output reducing from 100% at 253 V to 20% at 260 V.
volt_watt_not_adopted.boundary: Different DNSP; not automatically the Ausgrid Australia-A curve. Sufficient official provenance if an additional clearly labeled curve were needed; no additional curve is necessary once export-limit case is implemented.

connection_standard.verified_fact: Australia-A regional setting and inverter/network connection constraints are specified separately from simulated screening bands.
connection_standard.boundary: The manuscript 0.95-1.05 p.u. band remains an analytical screening band; do not call it a statutory compliance criterion.
